scan-bot: nightly gitleaks run -> HIGH confidence secret found in repo infra/thirdparty-lib (submodule)
scan-bot: path=vendor/old-fork/.env line=3 match=AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=********
maria: @aj can you pull the exact blob and confirm it's a prod service principal?
aj: grabbing it now, will run history scan
aj: ok confirmed: AZURE_CLIENT_ID=ab12... and AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET was present in that .env commit from 2022-09-14 in the submodule
kevin: do we have any cloud activity from that SP? checking audit logs
kevin: found activity: 2023-02-10 03:12 UTC from pipeline-runner-42 calling role assignments and creating storage containers (az cli UA: ci-agent/1.4)
olivia: that runner is retired but those artifacts might still exist in blob storage and our buildlog archive
maria: immediate containment: 1) revoke the SP creds 2) rotate any KMS keys if used 3) block the runner identity 4) snapshot cloud logs for forensic
kevin: started revocation: az ad sp credential reset --id ab12... --end-date "2022-09-15" (we set creds to disabled, rotation in progress)
kevin: also created a support ticket with azure to check for token misuse and refresh tokens
aj: running a repo-wide scan to find all occurrences:
```
# find commits touching submodule and grep for secret
git rev-list --all -- vendor/old-fork | xargs -n1 git grep -F --line-number "AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=" || true
```
aj: results: 3 hits across two repos (infra, onboarding-scripts). exporting commit SHAs to /tmp/sp-leak-shas.txt
olivia: buildlog retention policy is currently 90 days, but our old artifact-store kept nightly logs indefinitely for that period in 2022. we need to redact any stored logs that contain the secret
maria: action items (short):
- [P0] kevin: complete SP revoke and rotation, confirm no active tokens (due: now)
- [P0] aj: run backfill scan across all repos and forks, produce list (due: 2h)
- [P1] olivia: redact artifacts/buildlogs containing secret, update retention policy and mask rules (due: end of day)
- [P2] infra: add CI masking + fail build if secrets detected (gitleaks as pre-commit + GH action)
- [P2] security: run forensics on cloud audit logs and Sx to see lateral activity (due: 24h)
maria: sample redact command for blob storage:
```
az storage blob download --container-name buildlogs --name nightly/2022-09-14.log -f /tmp/log
sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/log | sed 's/AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=[^[:space:]]*/AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=[REDACTED]/g' > /tmp/log.redacted
az storage blob upload --container-name buildlogs --name nightly/2022-09-14.log -f /tmp/log.redacted --overwrite
```
aj: adding a scanning script to run across repos (short snippet):
```
for repo in $(cat /workspace/repolist.txt); do
  git -C /workspace/$repo fetch --all --quiet
  git -C /workspace/$repo rev-list --all | xargs -n1 git -C /workspace/$repo grep -F "AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=" --line-number || true
done
```
kevin: we should also search CI job env dumps and kubernetes pod logs where secrets might have been echoed. will query stackdriver and our S3/Blob archives
olivia: updated internal incident ticket INC-2026-047 and linked repo list + blob hits. tagging legal & compliance for retention guidance

aj: PRs incoming: - add gitleaks GH Action on push - fail on secret matches - pipeline change to mask env prints (set env: {CI_MASK_SECRETS: true})
maria: long-term follow ups: enforce KMS integration for service principals used by CI (don't store raw SP secrets), tighten RBAC so build agents use short-lived tokens with least privilege, increase scan cadence, and schedule a repo audit quarterly
olivia: created a post-incident checklist in the ticket and assigned owners. will update once redaction + rotation complete
maria: thanks team. update this thread when revocation confirmed and artifacts redacted. :white_check_mark:
